title: "Challengers"
jupyter: python3
format:
  html:
    echo: false
---

```{python}
#| output: asis

from helpers.challenger_metadata import (
    CHALLENGERS,
    challenger_forecasts_supplied_by_authors,
    challenger_note,
)
from helpers.s3_discovery import default_version, discover_downloaded_reports
from helpers.published_regions import published_region_ids, published_region_label

report_version = default_version()
published_reports = discover_downloaded_reports("reports", report_version)
region_labels = {
    region_id: published_region_label(region_id)
    for region_id in published_region_ids()
}
challengers = sorted({
    challenger_name
    for region_challengers in published_reports.values()
    for challenger_name in region_challengers
})

header = (
    "| System | Organisation | Method | Forecast type | Initial conditions | Output resolution | Report |\n"
    "|--------|--------------|--------|---------------|--------------------|-------------------|--------|\n"
)

def format_row(challenger_name):
    challenger_metadata = CHALLENGERS.get(challenger_name)
    report_links = "".join(
        f'<a class="region-report-badge" href="reports/{report_version}/{challenger_name}.{region_id}.report.html">'
        f"{region_labels[region_id]}</a>"
        for region_id, region_challengers in published_reports.items()
        if challenger_name in region_challengers
    )
    report_links = f'<span class="region-report-badges">{report_links}</span>' if report_links else ""
    if challenger_metadata:
        system = f"[{challenger_metadata['label']}]({challenger_metadata['url']})"
        if challenger_forecasts_supplied_by_authors(challenger_name):
            system += (
                '<sup class="run-by-marker" title="Forecasts supplied by the system authors">&dagger;</sup>'
            )
        note = challenger_note(challenger_name)
        if note:
            system += f'<sup class="challenger-note-marker" title="{note}">&Dagger;</sup>'
        organisation = (
            f"[{challenger_metadata['organisation']}]"
            f"({challenger_metadata['organisation_url']})"
        )
        return (
            f"| {system} | {organisation} | {challenger_metadata['method']} | "
            f"{challenger_metadata['forecast_type']} | {challenger_metadata['initial_conditions']} | "
            f"{challenger_metadata['resolution']} | {report_links} |"
        )
    return f"| {challenger_name} |  |  |  |  |  | {report_links} |"

rows = "\n".join(map(format_row, challengers))

print('<div class="challengers-table-wrap">\n\n' + header + rows + "\n\n</div>")

footnotes = []
if any(map(challenger_forecasts_supplied_by_authors, challengers)):
    footnotes.append(
        '<span class="challenger-note-entry">&dagger; Forecasts supplied by the system authors. '
        'All other forecasts were produced by running each system at '
        'Mercator Ocean.</span>'
    )

seen_notes = set()
for challenger_name in challengers:
    note = challenger_note(challenger_name)
    label = CHALLENGERS.get(challenger_name, {}).get("label", challenger_name)
    if not note or label in seen_notes:
        continue
    seen_notes.add(label)
    footnotes.append(f'<span class="challenger-note-entry">&Dagger; {label}: {note}</span>')

if footnotes:
    print('\n<p class="challengers-table-note">' + "".join(footnotes) + '</p>')
```
